purpose: Show how individual IgG measurements change from before to after vaccination, with prior-infection classes decoded. Preserve the literal participant pairing. Use a paired change view, not an unrelated association scatter.
mechanism: literal within-person connectors in class blocks
expected_benefit: Two class blocks keep before/after directions and literal connectors readable; saturated blue/pink dots and matching keys distinguish classes. The log axis and original units are explicit.
observed_tradeoff: Dense connector regions necessarily overlap; every pair and both endpoints remain present, and the black median/IQR guide remains readable.
record_timing: Purpose, roles, actual burden and concrete geometry were planned in create-intent.json, initial spec.json and agent working notes before first rendering; this durable summary was consolidated after bounded image review.
